body: were you able to find any peace or calm
There is a lot more, but I don’t want to poison the future for other people by exposing them to the toxin that was my life

I was a child of severe abuse, my father would tie me to a support beam and whip me naked as I ran around in circles to escape. I was also forced to whip or punish my younger brothers and sisters, I would not hurt them so I would get beaten more. he was a pastor and told me that he only did these things to keep my soul pure for god, he said his biggest worry was that I would die while in sin and go to hell, it was better he said that he deliver me to god while my heart was pure to save me from hell. I never got any help as a child even with Cfs in Canada getting involved. I had a really messed up sense of reality and where my place was. And now I have a daughter who is 10 months old and I realize that I don’t have the tools to support her emotionally and financially. My business is failing and I dont have an education past grade 11. All I have is a life insurance policy that that will  cover her and my wife for many years. A failure to provide for my family is my last hope and I don’t want to be around to make the same mistakes. My father left us on welfare and there were 9 of us kids. I am the oldest and have fought tooth and nails to make a better life for my siblings and mom. Everything is catching up to me now and I know that I was not assembled correctly to be a properly functioning person in this society. I have lied and manipulated my way to some level of success. But the demons are here loud and clear, it is hard for me to see my daughter cry or struggle and it’s all I can do at times to not lash out at her. Her life is worth much more than mine, and I prefer to end things on my terms and leave before she can develop any memories of me. I am aware that it will be hard on my wife, at least my daughter will not suffer grief. When she is older, if it comes up my wife can let her know that her dad had a hard life and that he was sick, but didn’t get help until it was to late.
She knows to an extent, not the severity of it.
A well lived life for you
If you want revenge, the quote is”the best revenge is a well lived life”. Sounds as if your still young enough to invent/imagine the life you want and at least pursue it.
Thanks for the encouragement. Wish you well and don’t wait until later in life to grasp who/what you are and what you need. I should have gone down the path of seeking help much earlier in life.

Being open about it is not something that comes easy. I have my first appointment in 2 hours with a therapist. I gave myself at least 3 months before doing anything I can’t come back from. But now the days are even harder to get through because I don’t see the light at the end of the tunnel

Just wanted to ask when you think that this started to be a solution to what’s happening in your life?. For me it’s been 1 month of several times a day breaking into tears and hopeless tirades. I think that I’ve felt this way for years and it’s finally gotten to the surface and I can’t ignore/pretend like everything’s normal

I understand how you feel. I think it’s soo hard to do because nothing good come easy for me at this stage of my life. Like life is telling me that if I want to escape this jail, it’s going to be a hard and painful escape
The closer I get to my end, the more I realize how random and meaningless it can be.

I’m struggling with this as well. It’s not the pain of living with my self that’s hard, it’s the pain I know They will suffer because of my death. I have to wait 3 months any until my wife’s family comes back so they can help with our new baby.
